1. (Currently Amended) A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, __wherein said first component comprises a humeral surface component having a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature, and said second component comprises a stem component__.

2. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said __humeral surface component__ is __removably attached to said__ stem __component__.

3. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said __humeral surface component__ has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature __and said humeral surface component has fins or spikes on a concave undersurface__.

4. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said coronal radius of curvature has a range of 10 to 50 mm.

5. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said axial radius of curvature has a range of from 10 to 50 mm.

6. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said __humeral surface component__ has a depth with a range of from 5 to 40 mm.

7. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said __humeral surface component__ has a thickness with a range of from 0.1 to 10 mm.

8. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein a ratio of a depth of said __humeral surface component__ to said coronal radius of curvature is from about 0.7 to about 0.9.

9. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said __humeral surface component__ is spherically or elliptically shaped __and comprises fins or spikes on a concave undersurface__.

10. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said __humeral surface component__ is made of a material selected from the group consisting of cobalt chrome alloy, ceramic, metal, and magnet materials.

11. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said __humeral surface component__ further comprises fins or spikes on a concave undersurface of said __humeral surface component__.

12. (Original) The implant of claim 3 further comprising a concave undersurface for bony ingrowth material.

13. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said __humeral surface component__ has a smooth articulating surface __and comprises fins or spikes on a concave undersurface__.

14. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said __removably__ attachable stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

15. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 14 wherein said __removably__ attachable stem is made of a material selected from the group consisting of titanium, stainless steel, tantalum, porous metal and trabecular metal.

16. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 15 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a smooth, textured or threaded surface.

17. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 16 wherein said removably attached stem is round, square, or triangular.

18. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises fins.

19. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a bony ingrowth surface.

20. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem __is selectable from a plurality of stems of different lengths, wherein said selected stem__ extends from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus.

21. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said __humeral surface component__ connects to said removably attached stem.

22. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said __humeral surface component__ connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper __connection__ and a screw __connection__.

27. (Currently Amended) A __method of implanting a__ glenohumeral joint __implant comprising providing__ a transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus and __inserting__ an implant __through said portal__.

28. (Currently Amended) The __method__ of claim 27 wherein said implant is a humeral implant.

29. (Currently Amended) A __humeral implant adapted for implantation in a__ humerus bone __and__ comprising a modular implant with a __humeral surface component__ and a stem, wherein said stem is __adapted to be__ anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of said humerus bone.

30. (Currently Amended) The __humeral implant__ of claim 29 wherein said stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

31. (Currently Amended) The __humeral implant__ of claim 30 wherein said stem is linear.
